title: Velora Visuals
description: A lightweight modpack that uses minimal resources but still delivers a shaders experience without actually using shaders.
body:
A lightweight modpack that uses minimal resources but still delivers a shader-like experience without actually using shaders.

Instead of heavy shader packs, it focuses on optimized visual mods and smart tweaks that enhance lighting, colors, shadows, and overall atmosphere in a way that feels clean and immersive.
